SX Tech and SX(O) trims discontinued; lineup now E, EX, EX(O), S(O), SX, SX Premium, King

release_timeline.event: First-generation Seltos launched in India
First-generation Seltos facelift
Second-generation Seltos unveiled (Korea/India/Europe/US)
Second-generation Seltos launched: 10 trims (HTE, HTE (O), HTK, HTK (O), HTX, HTX (A), GTX, X-Line, GTX (A), X-Line (A)), Rs 10.99-19.99 lakh
Bharat NCAP 5-star rating announced (AOP 31.70/32, COP 45/49)
GTX (O) and X-Line (O) top variants launched (ADAS F+ pack, HUD, dash cam) at Rs 21.57 lakh; line-wide price hike of up to Rs 33,000

models.price_basis: Ex-showroom Delhi/pan-India per CarDekho and v3cars price lists updated Oct-2026 (post 1-Jul-2026 revision); sources publish lakh figures so prices are to the nearest Rs 1,000.
